articles.title: Artists and Fans Pay Tribute to Duran Duran Guitarist Andy Taylor
articles.summary: Fans and fellow artists are paying tribute to Andy Taylor, the guitarist of Duran Duran and a Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductee, after his death this week at age 65. Taylor died Monday after a yearslong battle with stage 4 metastatic prostate cancer. articles.title: What The Hunting Wives—And The Hunting Wives Alone—Understands About How to Make Addictive TV
articles.summary: This article discusses the full second season of The Hunting Wives. The Hunting Wives , whose second season has arrived on Netflix just in time to distract fans from our feasting families, isn’t so different from TV’s dozens of other soapy thrillers on paper. articles.title: What to Know About the Case Behind Netflix's New True-Crime Docuseries The Trials of Karen Read
articles.summary: On Jan. 29, 2022, Boston police officer John O’Keefe, 46, was found dead in the snow outside of his friend’s home in Canton, Mass. His girlfriend, Karen Read , was arrested and accused of second-degree murder and manslaughter, with authorities alleging that she ran over O’Keefe in her SUV while driving under the influence, then left him in the snow to die. articles.title: Breaking Down the Ending of The Remarried Empress
articles.summary: It’s hard to imagine The Remarried Empress appearing on a streamer other than Disney+. The K-drama plays out like a fairy tale. Adapted from a massively successful webcomic and webtoon of the same name, the series stars Hometown Cha Cha Cha ’s Shin Min-a as the empress of a fictional Eastern Empire.
